item.title: Annual Kern County homeless population count finishes with crucial data
item.description: Hundreds of volunteers gathered before the sun was up to get crucial data on one of Kern's most vulnerable populations. The annual point-in-time count gives a sense of how many homeless people are in our county, which contributes to national funding for programs.
